subject: general
question: As per the 18th Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), the unemployment rate among females (aged 15 years and above) in urban areas declined to ________ in January March 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is **0.092**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **18th Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** showed a decline in the unemployment rate among females aged 15 years and above in urban areas to **0.092** in January-March 2023.
 
• This survey provides essential data on the labor force participation rates, employment, and unemployment in both rural and urban settings across India.
 
• The PLFS is conducted by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, which operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
 
• The survey's findings are crucial for policy-making and planning for employment generation and skill development among the workforce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Survey Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Objective**
 Assess the employment and unemployment status within India's population.
 
 

 **Frequency**
 Conducted annually to provide regular updates.
 
 

 **Coverage**
 Includes both rural and urban areas to ensure comprehensive data collection.
 
 

 **Importance**
 Helps in understanding the dynamics of the labor market and guiding employment policies.
 
 

 **Agency**
 The National Statistical Office (NSO) is responsible for the execution and publication of the survey.
